messages.text:
"Create a 2D side-scrolling action game inspired by Tower Hunter: Erza's Trial.

Main Character:
- Female sword fighter
- Uses a one-handed sword
- Fast movement and responsive controls
- Can run, jump, double jump, wall jump, and dash

Combat:
- Light attack combo
- Heavy attack
- Air attack
- Dodge roll
- Enemy knockback

Enemies:
- Slimes
- Goblins
- Flying bats

Level Design:
- Fantasy tower
- Multiple platform sections
- Hidden treasure rooms
- Simple environmental hazards

Boss:
- Giant armored knight
- Multiple attack patterns
- Second phase below 50% health

Art Style:
- Anime-inspired fantasy
- Bright colors
- Smooth character animations

Goal:
- Reach the top of the tower and defeat the boss.

Keep the project simple, playable, and beginner-friendly.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
